summary: Iteration 122 — Arşiv v2 frontend (web + mobile) end-to-end verified. All 8 checklist items PASS. Web: SettingsPanel Arşiv tab renders 3 policy radios + autoclean toggle + day chips (7/15/30/60/90/Özel + Uygula). Toggling policy → 'Ayar kaydedildi' toast. With policy=required + autoclean=30 enabled, DELETE without reason returns 400 (backend enforcement working). Cancel-with-reason and delete-with-reason show correctly in archive: task-cancel-reason-<id> = 'İptal nedeni: Müşteri iptal etti', task-delete-reason-<id> = 'Silme nedeni: Sipariş iptal', task-autoclean-<id> = '30 gün sonra kalıcı silinecek'. Sort chips (Yeni/Eski/A-Z) and archive-internal search filter correctly. Global search (active view) shows 'ARŞİVDE BULUNANLAR' section with archive-search-row-<id> rows that navigate to the correct archive group. archive-empty-trash & ctx-permanent-delete visible for admin. UserLockPolicyModal shows archive-caps-section with all 3 toggles (archive-cap-perm_delete/-empty_trash/-manage_policy) for admin. Mobile: /archive route shows archive-screen with archive-group-done/-cancelled/-deleted chips, archive-search-input, and archive-sort-new/-old/-az; archive-empty-trash-button correctly hidden when deleted=0. Task detail exposes task-detail-cancel-button + task-detail-delete-button. Backend cleanup performed (policy reset to optional, autoclean disabled, all TEST_ tasks purged).
critical_code_review_comments: All spec testIDs verified live in the DOM on both platforms (web: settings-tab-archive, policy-{optional,required,off}, autoclean-toggle, autoclean-day-{7,15,30,60,90,custom,apply}, archive-caps-section, archive-cap-{perm_delete,empty_trash,manage_policy}, prompt-input, task-cancel-reason-<id>, task-delete-reason-<id>, task-autoclean-<id>, archive-sort + archive-sort-{new,old,az}, task-search-input, archive-search-results, archive-search-row-<id>; mobile: archive-screen, archive-group-{done,cancelled,deleted}, archive-search-input, archive-sort-{new,old,az}, archive-empty-trash-button, task-detail-cancel-button, task-detail-delete-button).
Backend policy=required is enforced at API layer: raw DELETE /api/tasks/<id> without reason returned HTTP 400 as expected.
Autoclean days label correctly formatted in Turkish: '30 gün sonra kalıcı silinecek'.

Global search integration: setting task-search-input while in active view triggers /api/tasks/search?scope=archive and renders archive-search-results; row click flips showArchived=true and jumps to the correct group.
Admin gating verified live: archive-empty-trash and archive-caps-section both render for serkan (admin).
Low-severity carry-over from previous iterations: TasksPanel.jsx is ~2729 lines — recommend future refactor/splitting (not blocking).

Minor: `task-search-input` is a single testID reused across active view and archive view; both flows work correctly but tests should be aware the same selector filters different lists depending on showArchived state.
